issues.issue: Had the applicant completed or constructively served his US sentence before leaving?
issues.applicant_position: He constructively served his sentence: the voluntary departure order prevented probation surveillance, so his departure was involuntary.
issues.respondent_position: Sentence not completed: five-year probation largely unserved; he left voluntarily, so it is not a deportation.
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that the Applicant did not complete his sentence in the United States.

issues.issue: Is Article 1F(b) inapplicable to a person who has served a sentence abroad before coming to Canada (Chan versus Zrig)?
issues.applicant_position: Under Chan, Article 1F(b) is confined to fugitives and does not apply to those who served their sentence abroad.
issues.respondent_position: Under Zrig, Article 1F(b) is not limited to extraditable fugitives; whether a sentence was served is irrelevant.
